text:

席卷对手进行攻击。

label: ITEMINFO_1220

与对手嬉闹并攻击。

label: ITEMINFO_1223

label: ITEMINFO_1224

使出全身力量，
猛攻对手。

text:

text:

text:

text:

text:

label: ITEMINFO_1579
text:
极巨化的蜂女王制造出的蜜汁。
放进极巨汤里，就能让汤的味道变得很温和。
与活力块具有相同的效果。

label: ITEMINFO_1580
text:
拥有某种神奇力量的蘑菇，
能改变宝可梦极巨化的样子。
在战斗中，可以提高宝可梦所有的能力。

label: ITEMINFO_1581
text:
伽勒尔部分地区生长的
伽勒豆蔻这种植物的枝条。
可以用来制作某种宝可梦的饰品。

label: ITEMINFO_1582
text:
用伽勒豆蔻枝编织的手环。
给伽勒尔地区的呆呆兽戴上，
它就会很开心。

label: ITEMINFO_1583
text:
拥有后，在时装店可以买到的物品
和在美发沙龙可以选择的发型
都会有所增加的卡片。

label: ITEMINFO_1584
text:
前往铠岛的车票。
在木杆镇的车站，
把它出示给站务员看吧。

label: ITEMINFO_1585
text:
能借助洛托姆的力量进行涡轮加速，
且可在水面上骑行的自行车。
洁白耀眼的闪亮白。

label: ITEMINFO_1586
text:
能借助洛托姆的力量进行涡轮加速，
且可在水面上骑行的自行车。
闪烁着红黑色光泽的炫耀黑。

label: ITEMINFO_1587
text:
能够伸得很长的神奇护符。
训练家拥有它之后，
宝可梦获得的经验值就会增加。

label: ITEMINFO_1588
text:
能够在铠岛找出的珍稀石头。
把它送给铠岛的收藏家，
就会有好事发生。

label: ITEMINFO_1589
text:
神奇而富有个性的护符。
拥有该护符后，
会更容易遇到带有证章的宝可梦。

label: ITEMINFO_1590
text:
人们曾经用来进献给国王的缰绳。
可增强丰饶之力，
并使蕾冠王与爱马合二为一。

label: ITEMINFO_1591
text:
人们曾经用来进献给国王的缰绳。
通过缰绳连接的二者可以相互交流。
可使蕾冠王与爱马一分为二。

label: ITEMINFO_1592
text:
用伽勒豆蔻枝编织的花环头饰。
给伽勒尔地区的呆呆兽戴上这种头饰，
它就会很开心。

label: ITEMINFO_1593
text:
皮欧尼整理的
有关丰饶之王传说的笔记。
上面贴着很旧的照片。

label: ITEMINFO_1594
text:
皮欧尼整理的
有关巨人传说的笔记。
上面绘有充满个性的画。

label: ITEMINFO_1595
text:
皮欧尼整理的
有关鸟宝可梦传说的笔记。
上面绘有充满个性的画。

label: ITEMINFO_1596
text:
皮欧尼掉落的神秘笔记。
上面贴有极巨巢穴
出现光洞的照片。

label: ITEMINFO_1597
text:
前往王冠雪原的车票。
在木杆镇的车站，
把它出示给站务员看吧。

label: ITEMINFO_1598
text:
用木头雕制而成的神秘物体。
上面有看起来缺了什么的痕迹。
可能是其他物品的一部分。

label: ITEMINFO_1599
text:
从丰饶之王那里
得到的一片花瓣。
散发着朦胧的光辉。

label: ITEMINFO_1600
text:
丰饶之王的爱马
雪暴马的鬃毛。
既结实又柔韧。

label: ITEMINFO_1601
text:
丰饶之王的爱马
灵幽马的鬃毛。
摸起来非常柔顺。

label: ITEMINFO_1602
text:
丰饶之王的爱马
喜欢吃的农作物。
生长于白雪皑皑的田地。

label: ITEMINFO_1603
text:
丰饶之王的爱马
喜欢吃的农作物。
生长于光线暗淡的田地。

label: ITEMINFO_1604
text:
能够在极巨巢穴找出的神秘石头。
把它送给王冠雪原的收藏家，
就会有好事发生。

label: ITEMINFO_1605
text:
种在田地里使用的种子。
出产的萝卜种类会根据
种下的田地而有所不同。

label: ITEMINFO_1606
text:
可以改变宝可梦特性的膏药。
给拥有常见特性的宝可梦使用后，
其特性会转变为稀有特性。

label: ITEMINFO_1607
text:
拿到光下即可生辉的布。
人们曾经将其进献给
丰饶之王以表感谢之意。

label: ITEMINFO_1608
text:
蕴含着不可思议力量的
投掷用道具。能让狂暴的
帝牙卢卡镇静下来。

label: ITEMINFO_1609
text:
蕴含着不可思议力量的
投掷用道具。能让狂暴的
帕路奇亚镇静下来。

label: ITEMINFO_1610
text: 与阿尔宙斯对战时使用的神秘球体。

label: ITEMINFO_1611
text:
蕴藏着不可思议能量的绳子，
能从中感受到某种联系。
某种宝可梦们很喜欢它。

label: ITEMINFO_1612
text:
伽勒尔地区常见的点心。
用树果等材料制成，
爱吃这种点心的宝可梦意外地多。

label: ITEMINFO_1613
text:
外壳可当成胶囊状容器使用，
是被用来制作各种精灵球的树果。
正式名称是茶球果。

label: ITEMINFO_1614
text:
祝庆村不为人知的特产，是宝可梦
喜爱的食物，如今正渐渐流行起来。
吃下后能治愈异常状态。

label: ITEMINFO_1615
text:
大大提高战斗中宝可梦
进攻力和防守力的道具。
离场后，效果便会消失。

label: ITEMINFO_1616
text:
大大提高战斗中宝可梦
击中要害机率的道具。
离场后，效果便会消失。

label: ITEMINFO_1617
text:
使用后会让宝可梦陷入热衷的粽子。
所热衷的招式给予的伤害会增加，
同时自己受到的伤害也会增加。

label: ITEMINFO_1618
text:
可让宝可梦获得加倍效果的腌菜。
使用后宝可梦的招式造成的伤害
会暂时变成１.５倍。

label: ITEMINFO_1619
text:
不可思议的食物。
使用后可让宝可梦的
进攻力和防守力暂时互换。

label: ITEMINFO_1620
text:
能作为投掷用道具的材料使用的
蕨类植物。将卷成漩涡状的叶片
展开后，就是一张天然的包装纸。

label: ITEMINFO_1621
text:
稀有的种子。将它交给警卫组
组长，就能让宝可梦的招式
在迅疾与刚猛之间切换。

label: ITEMINFO_1624
text:
雪原王冰岩怪喜爱的冰柱。
据说是遥远过去的某只
冰岩怪身体的一部分。

label: ITEMINFO_1625
text:
完成了住在睿智湖的知识之神
由克希的考验的证明。
制造红色锁链时的必备品。

label: ITEMINFO_1626
text:
完成了住在立志湖的意志之神
亚克诺姆的考验的证明。
制造红色锁链时的必备品。

label: ITEMINFO_1627
text:

text:
带有甜味的食材。
味道本身虽淡薄但有深度，
吃起来足够让人满足。

label: ITEMINFO_1920
text:
咸味强烈的食材。
充分煎至焦脆程度恰到好处，
因此香味与鲜味十足。

label: ITEMINFO_1921
text:
咸味强烈的食材。
因为其咸味很足，所以与
蔬菜类的食材非常搭配。

label: ITEMINFO_1922
text:
咸味很强的食材。
因为与火腿不同，并没有加热，
所以能享受新鲜的味道。

label: ITEMINFO_1923
text:
咸味和辣味强烈的食材。
咸味十足的香肠，
够辣的类型很受欢迎。

label: ITEMINFO_1924
text:
咸味和苦味强烈的食材。
极强的咸味和香草的苦味
相互平衡讨人喜爱。

label: ITEMINFO_1925
text:
咸味强烈的食材。
如果希望三明治能吃得
让人满足，就绝不能少了它。

label: ITEMINFO_1926
text:
甜味和咸味强烈的食材。
由毛崖蟹脱下的壳的萃取物
调制而成的健康加工食品。

label: ITEMINFO_1927
text:
咸味和苦味强烈的食材。
带有通过熏制得到的独特风味，
与蔬菜类食材特别搭配。

label: ITEMINFO_1928
text:
咸味和苦味强烈的食材。
若要用来制作三明治，
调味时最好加入酸味。

label: ITEMINFO_1929
text:
带有咸味的食材。
能以各种调味品尝
且营养充足的食材。

label: ITEMINFO_1930
text:
咸味强烈的食材。
在帕底亚是很有人气的料理。
拥有充足的份量。

label: ITEMINFO_1931
text:
带有甜味的食材。
生豆腐。作为三明治
馅料的潜力还是未知数。

text:
带有甜味的食材。

馅料的潜力还是未知数。

煮熟的面。作为三明治
馅料的潜力还是未知数。

text:
酸味强烈的食材。
以土豆为主的沙拉。
与面包的搭配程度不容小觑。

label: ITEMINFO_1935
text:
带有咸味的食材。
切成薄片的芝士。方便使用，
适合用作三明治的馅料。

label: ITEMINFO_1936
text:
甜味强烈的食材。
甘甜味美，是很多宝可梦
都喜爱的经典水果。

label: ITEMINFO_1937
text:
酸味和甜味强烈的食材。
三明治只要夹了它就能变得抢镜，
因此是一种十分有人气的食材。

label: ITEMINFO_1938
text:
甜味强烈的食材。
切成了片，作为三明治馅料
用起来十分方便。

label: ITEMINFO_1939
text:
酸味强烈的食材。
带有很强酸味和淡淡的甜味。
与油腻的食材很搭配。

label: ITEMINFO_1940
text:
酸味强烈的食材。
能让人大饱眼福和口福的南国果实。
被切成了容易吃的形状。

label: ITEMINFO_1941
text:
辣味强烈的食材。
由于辣味非常之强，
所以是喜恶两极化的食材。

label: ITEMINFO_1942
text:
辣味强烈的调味料。

与油腻的馅料很搭配。

label: ITEMINFO_1943
text:
辣味强烈的调味料。

下太多可会抢掉其他食材的味道。

text:

text:
苦味强烈的食材。

text:
苦味强烈的食材。

十分芳香，与番茄很搭配。

label: ITEMINFO_1074
text:
用于参加道馆挑战
这一大赛的推荐函。

label: ITEMINFO_1075
text:
可以随时访问
宝可梦中心电脑里的盒子，
来寄放或领回需要的宝可梦。

label: ITEMINFO_1076
text:
这是一块在伽勒尔地区发现的
蕴含着神奇力量的石头。听说
捡到它的人能实现自己的愿望。

label: ITEMINFO_1077
text:
内部嵌入了许愿星，
在能量点就会发出光芒，
使宝可梦极巨化。

label: ITEMINFO_1080
text:
在有水的地方使用，
就能钓到各种各样的宝可梦。

label: ITEMINFO_1081
text:
宝可梦洛托姆潜入马达后，
这辆自行车变得可以
通过涡轮发动机加速了。

label: ITEMINFO_1084
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。白香肠是香肠的一种。
需要先煮过之后再食用。

label: ITEMINFO_1085
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。不知是什么原因，
饱伯卖的罐头在伽勒尔特别受欢迎。

label: ITEMINFO_1086
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。不知是什么原因，
巴哈卖的罐头在伽勒尔特别受欢迎。

label: ITEMINFO_1087
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。放进料理里一起煮，
豆子的那种香甜就会散发出来。

label: ITEMINFO_1088
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。同时也是用于吸干盘中
最后一滴咖喱的秘密武器。

label: ITEMINFO_1089
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。是由小麦粉揉制的面条。
搭配咖喱出乎意料地美味。

label: ITEMINFO_1090
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。各种菌菇混在一起的嚼劲
会为口感带来变化。

label: ITEMINFO_1091
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。宝可梦呆呆兽的尾巴
就算断掉也会很快长出新的。

label: ITEMINFO_1092
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。不知是不是宝可梦
大葱鸭最爱的那种植物的茎。

label: ITEMINFO_1093
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。历经千挑万选的苹果
不仅形状饱满，表皮更是亮泽鲜艳。

label: ITEMINFO_1094
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。将骨头精心熬煮而得的
一丝浓缩的精华加深了料理的美味。

label: ITEMINFO_1095
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。土豆能中和辣味，
使整道料理的滋味变得柔和。

label: ITEMINFO_1096
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。将信手摘取的香草
点缀在上面，使料理更加色香味俱全。

label: ITEMINFO_1097
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。将各种蔬菜搭配到一起，
看上去就非常有益健康。

label: ITEMINFO_1098
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。炸完出锅后
放置了一段时间，所以稍稍有些油腻。

label: ITEMINFO_1099
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。只需一个水煮蛋，
整道料理的水准都能得到升华。

label: ITEMINFO_1100
text:
可以在旷野地带
或露营营地上搭起帐篷，
在那里制作料理。

label: ITEMINFO_1074
text:
用于参加道馆挑战
这一大赛的推荐函。

label: ITEMINFO_1075
text:
可以随时访问
宝可梦中心电脑里的盒子，
来寄放或领回需要的宝可梦。

label: ITEMINFO_1076
text:
这是一块在伽勒尔地区发现的
蕴含着神奇力量的石头。听说
捡到它的人能实现自己的愿望。

label: ITEMINFO_1077
text:
内部嵌入了许愿星，
在能量点就会发出光芒，
使宝可梦极巨化。

label: ITEMINFO_1080
text:
在有水的地方使用，
就能钓到各种各样的宝可梦。

label: ITEMINFO_1081
text:
宝可梦洛托姆潜入马达后，
这辆自行车变得可以
通过涡轮发动机加速了。

label: ITEMINFO_1084
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。白香肠是香肠的一种。
需要先煮过之后再食用。

label: ITEMINFO_1085
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。不知是什么原因，
饱伯卖的罐头在伽勒尔特别受欢迎。

label: ITEMINFO_1086
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。不知是什么原因，
巴哈卖的罐头在伽勒尔特别受欢迎。

label: ITEMINFO_1087
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。放进料理里一起煮，
豆子的那种香甜就会散发出来。

label: ITEMINFO_1088
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。同时也是用于吸干盘中
最后一滴咖喱的秘密武器。

label: ITEMINFO_1089
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。是由小麦粉揉制的面条。
搭配咖喱出乎意料地美味。

label: ITEMINFO_1090
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。各种菌菇混在一起的嚼劲
会为口感带来变化。

label: ITEMINFO_1091
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。宝可梦呆呆兽的尾巴
就算断掉也会很快长出新的。

label: ITEMINFO_1092
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。不知是不是宝可梦
大葱鸭最爱的那种植物的茎。

label: ITEMINFO_1093
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。历经千挑万选的苹果
不仅形状饱满，表皮更是亮泽鲜艳。

label: ITEMINFO_1094
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。将骨头精心熬煮而得的
一丝浓缩的精华加深了料理的美味。

label: ITEMINFO_1095
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。土豆能中和辣味，
使整道料理的滋味变得柔和。

label: ITEMINFO_1096
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。将信手摘取的香草
点缀在上面，使料理更加色香味俱全。

label: ITEMINFO_1097
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。将各种蔬菜搭配到一起，
看上去就非常有益健康。

label: ITEMINFO_1098
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。炸完出锅后
放置了一段时间，所以稍稍有些油腻。

label: ITEMINFO_1099
text:
在露营营地制作料理时会使用的
一种食材。只需一个水煮蛋，
整道料理的水准都能得到升华。

label: ITEMINFO_1100
text:
可以在旷野地带
或露营营地上搭起帐篷，
在那里制作料理。

the holder.

the holder.

one move.

holder every turn and may latch on to Pokémon
that touch the holder.

but allows the holder’s Attack stat to grow more
after battling.

carapace enables the holder to switch out of battle
without fail.

label: ITEMINFO_296

An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the
amount of HP the holder restores from
HP-stealing moves.

An item to be held by a Pokémon. These curious

one move.

label: ITEMINFO_315
text:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
This exotic-smelling incense boosts the
power of Rock-type moves.

label: ITEMINFO_316
text:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
This exotic-smelling incense makes the
holder bloated and slow moving.

label: ITEMINFO_317
text:
An item to be held by a Pokémon. This incense has
a curious aroma that boosts the power of
Water-type moves.

label: ITEMINFO_318
text:
An item to be held by a Pokémon.
This exotic-smelling incense boosts the
power of Grass-type moves.

label: ITEMINFO_319
text:
An item to be held by a Pokémon. It doubles any
prize money received if the holding Pokémon joins
a battle.

label: ITEMINFO_320
text:
An item to be held by a Pokémon. It helps keep
wild Pokémon away if the holder is the head of
the party.

label: ITEMINFO_321
text:
A protective item of some sort. It is extremely stiff
and heavy. It’s loved by a certain Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_322
text:
A box packed with a tremendous amount of electric
energy. It’s loved by a certain Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_323
text:
A box packed with a tremendous amount of magma
energy. It’s loved by a certain Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_324
text:
A transparent device overflowing with dubious
data. Its producer is unknown.

label: ITEMINFO_325
text:
A cloth imbued with horrifyingly strong spiritual
energy. It’s loved by a certain Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_326
text:
An item to be held by a Pokémon. This sharply
hooked claw increases the holder’s
critical-hit ratio.

label: ITEMINFO_327
text:
An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder
successfully inflicts damage, the target may
also flinch.

label: ITEMINFO_328
text:
The user focuses its mind before launching a punch.
This move fails if the user is hit before it is used.

label: ITEMINFO_329
text: The user slashes the target with huge sharp claws.

label: ITEMINFO_330
text:
The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of
water. This may also confuse the target.

label: ITEMINFO_331
text:
The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its
spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

label: ITEMINFO_332
text:
The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is
dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a
single Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_333
text:
A move that leaves the target badly poisoned.
Its poison damage worsens every turn.

label: ITEMINFO_334
text:
The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns.
It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.

label: ITEMINFO_335
text:
The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body,
raising both its Attack and Defense stats.

label: ITEMINFO_336
text:
The user forcefully shoots seeds at the target two
to five times in a row.

label: ITEMINFO_337
text:
The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk
stats increase.

label: ITEMINFO_338
text:
The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering
up Fire-type moves. It lowers the power of
Water-type moves.

label: ITEMINFO_339
text:
The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use
only attack moves for three turns.

label: ITEMINFO_340
text:
The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy.
This may also leave the target frozen.

label: ITEMINFO_341
text:
A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing
Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing
Pokémon frozen.

label: ITEMINFO_342
text:
The target is attacked with a powerful beam.
The user can’t move on the next turn.

label: ITEMINFO_343
text:
A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage
from special attacks for five turns.

label: ITEMINFO_344
text:
This move enables the user to protect itself from
all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used
in succession.

label: ITEMINFO_345
text:
The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five
turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers
the power of Fire-type moves.

label: ITEMINFO_346
text:
A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored
by half the damage taken by the target.

label: ITEMINFO_347
text:
The user creates a protective field that prevents
status conditions for five turns.

label: ITEMINFO_348
text:
The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a
powerful flash.

label: ITEMINFO_349
text:
In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light, then
blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

label: ITEMINFO_350
text:
The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail.
This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

label: ITEMINFO_351
text:
A strong electric blast crashes down on the target.
This may also leave the target with paralysis.

label: ITEMINFO_352
text:
A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to
inflict damage. This may also leave the target
with paralysis.

label: ITEMINFO_353
text:
The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every
Pokémon around it.

label: ITEMINFO_354
text:
The user makes a swift attack on the target’s legs,
which lowers the target’s Speed stat.

label: ITEMINFO_355
text:
The user burrows into the ground, then attacks on the
next turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

label: ITEMINFO_356
text:
The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force.
This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

label: ITEMINFO_357
text:
The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target.
This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

label: ITEMINFO_358
text:
The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break
barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

label: ITEMINFO_359
text:
By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of
itself to raise its evasiveness.

label: ITEMINFO_360
text:
A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage
from physical attacks for five turns.

label: ITEMINFO_361
text:
The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of
electricity. This attack never misses.

label: ITEMINFO_362
text:
The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire.
This may also leave the target with a burn.

label: ITEMINFO_363
text:
Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may
also poison the target.

label: ITEMINFO_364
text:
A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all
combatants except Rock, Ground, and Steel types.
It raises the Sp. Def stat of Rock types.

label: ITEMINFO_365
text:
The target is attacked with an intense blast of
all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target
with a burn.

label: ITEMINFO_366
text:
Boulders are hurled at the target. This also lowers
the target’s Speed stat by preventing its movement.

label: ITEMINFO_367
text:
The user confounds the target with speed, then
slashes. This attack never misses.

label: ITEMINFO_368
text:
The user torments and enrages the target, making it
incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

label: ITEMINFO_369
text:
This attack move doubles its power if the user is
poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

label: ITEMINFO_370
text:
After making its attack, the user rushes back to
switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

label: ITEMINFO_371
text:
The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully
restores the user’s HP and heals any
status conditions.

label: ITEMINFO_372
text:
If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target
becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

label: ITEMINFO_373
text:
The user attacks and steals the target’s held item
simultaneously. The user can’t steal anything if it
already holds an item.

label: ITEMINFO_374
text:
The target is hit with wings of steel. This may also
raise the user’s Defense stat.

label: ITEMINFO_375
text:
The user employs its psychic power to exchange
Abilities with the target.

label: ITEMINFO_376
text:
The user shoots boiling hot water at its target.
This may also leave the target with a burn.

label: ITEMINFO_377
text:
The user attacks the target at full power. The attack’s
recoil harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

label: ITEMINFO_378
text:
The user lands and rests its body. This move restores
the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

label: ITEMINFO_379
text:
The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes
its power. This may also lower the target’s
Sp. Def stat.

label: ITEMINFO_380
text:
The user draws power from nature and fires it at the
target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

label: ITEMINFO_381
text:
A restrained attack that prevents the target from
fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

label: ITEMINFO_382
text:
If the target’s HP is half or less, this attack will hit
with double the power.

label: ITEMINFO_383
text:
The user flings its held item at the target to attack.
This move’s power and effects depend on the item.

label: ITEMINFO_384
text:
The user attacks the target with an electric charge.
The user may use any remaining electricity to raise its
Sp. Atk stat.

label: ITEMINFO_385
text:
The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP.
Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

label: ITEMINFO_386
text:
The target is attacked with a shock wave generated
by the user’s gaping mouth.

label: ITEMINFO_387
text:
An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored
by half the damage taken by the target.

label: ITEMINFO_388
text:
The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict
a burn.

label: ITEMINFO_389
text:
The user generates a damaging sound wave by
vibration. This may also lower the target’s
Sp. Def stat.

label: ITEMINFO_390
text:
The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad
thoughts. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

label: ITEMINFO_391
text:
The user attacks everything around it by causing a
tremendous explosion. The user faints upon using
this move.

label: ITEMINFO_392
text:
The user slashes with a sharp claw made from
shadows. Critical hits land more easily.

label: ITEMINFO_393
text:
The user stores power, then attacks. If the user
moves after the target, this attack’s power will
be doubled.

label: ITEMINFO_394
text:
The user recycles a held item that has been used in
battle so it can be used again.

label: ITEMINFO_395
text:
The user charges at the target using every bit of its
power. The user can’t move on the next turn.

label: ITEMINFO_396
text:
The user polishes its body to reduce drag.
This sharply raises the Speed stat.

label: ITEMINFO_397
text:
The user flashes a light that lowers the target’s accuracy.
It can also be used to illuminate caves.

label: ITEMINFO_398
text:
The user stabs the target from below with
sharpened stones. Critical hits land more easily.

label: ITEMINFO_399
text:
The power of this attack move is doubled if the user
has been hurt by the target in the same turn.

label: ITEMINFO_400
text:
The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that
paralyzes the target.

label: ITEMINFO_401
text:
The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin.
The slower the user compared to the target, the
greater the move’s power.

label: ITEMINFO_402
text:
A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit.
This sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

label: ITEMINFO_403
text:
The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the
opposing team. The trap hurts opposing Pokémon
that switch into battle.

label: ITEMINFO_404
text:
The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat
change made by the target.

label: ITEMINFO_405
text:
The user yells as if it’s ranting about something,
which lowers the Sp. Atk stats of opposing Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_406
text:
The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark
thoughts. This may also make the target flinch.

label: ITEMINFO_407
text:
Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to
inflict damage. This may also make the opposing
Pokémon flinch.

label: ITEMINFO_408
text:
The user slashes at the target by crossing its
scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

label: ITEMINFO_409
text:
While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the
moves it knows.

label: ITEMINFO_410
text:
The user strikes everything around it by stomping
down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of
those hit.

label: ITEMINFO_411
text:
The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like
steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

label: ITEMINFO_412
text:
The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target.
The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by
the target.

label: ITEMINFO_413
text:
The user snares the target with grass and trips it.
The heavier the target, the greater the
move’s power.

label: ITEMINFO_414
text:
The user enrages and confuses the target. However,
this also sharply raises the target’s Attack stat.

label: ITEMINFO_415
text:
The user pecks the target. If the target is holding a
Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

label: ITEMINFO_416
text:
After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch
places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

label: ITEMINFO_417
text:
The user creates a substitute for itself using some of
its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

label: ITEMINFO_418
text:
The user gathers all its light energy and releases it
all at once. This may also lower the target’s
Sp. Def stat.

label: ITEMINFO_419
text:
The user creates a bizarre area in which slower
Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

label: ITEMINFO_420
text:
The target is cut with a scythe or claw. It’s also one of
the Pokétch’s hidden moves.

label: ITEMINFO_421
text:
The user flies up into the sky and then strikes its target
on the next turn. It’s also one of the Pokétch’s
hidden moves.

label: ITEMINFO_422
text:
The user attacks everything around it by swamping its
surroundings with a giant wave. It’s also one of the
Pokétch’s hidden moves.

label: ITEMINFO_423
text:
The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum
power. It’s also one of the Pokétch’s hidden moves.

label: ITEMINFO_424
text:
A strong wind blows away the target’s barriers, such as
Reflect or Light Screen, and lowers their evasiveness.
It’s also one of the Pokétch’s hidden moves.

label: ITEMINFO_425
text:
The user attacks with a punch that may lower the
target’s Defense stat. It’s also one of the Pokétch’s
hidden moves.

label: ITEMINFO_426
text:
The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.
It’s also one of the Pokétch’s hidden moves.

label: ITEMINFO_427
text:
A charging attack that may also leave the foe confused.
It’s also one of the Pokétch’s hidden moves.

label: ITEMINFO_428
text:
A bag filled with convenient tools for exploring.
It provides access to the Grand Underground.

label: ITEMINFO_429
text:
A sturdy, spacious bag that is used to carry any
treasures or loot obtained in the coal mine.

label: ITEMINFO_430
text:
It lists the rules for holding battles.
For Link Battles, you may choose which set of rules
you wish to use.

label: ITEMINFO_431
text:
A tool that can search out Pokémon that are hiding
in the tall grass. Its battery is recharged as
you walk.

label: ITEMINFO_432
text:
A card that lists how many Battle Points you
have earned.

label: ITEMINFO_433
text: A book full of useful information for your adventure.

label: ITEMINFO_434
text:
A case for storing Stickers that can be applied to
Ball Capsules.

label: ITEMINFO_435
text:
A lovely case to store colorful Props for your
Pokémon to wear in a musical.

label: ITEMINFO_436
text:
A tiny bag that can hold 10 Stickers for decorating
Poké Balls.

label: ITEMINFO_437
text:
A convenient notepad that is used to register your
friends and friend codes and keep a record of
your gameplay.

label: ITEMINFO_438
text:
A large key for operating the doors of the
Valley Windworks in the canyon. It was held by
a Team Galactic Grunt.

label: ITEMINFO_439
text:
An ancient good-luck charm made of Pokémon
bones to be taken to the elder of Celestic Town.

label: ITEMINFO_440
text:
A card key for disengaging the security systems in
the Galactic HQ. Losing it can result in
punishment, apparently.

label: ITEMINFO_441
text:
A mythical chain that is said to link the
Legendary Pokémon that created the Sinnoh region.

label: ITEMINFO_442
text:
A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime.
It even shows you your present location in the region.

label: ITEMINFO_443
text:
A device that indicates Trainers who want to
battle. Its battery charges while you walk.

label: ITEMINFO_444
text:
A case for holding coins obtained at the
Game Corner. It can hold up to 50,000 coins.

label: ITEMINFO_445
text:
An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it at any body
of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_446
text:
A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it at any body
of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_447
text:
An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it at any
body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_448
text:
A watering can shaped like a Psyduck. It helps
promote the healthy growth of any Berries planted
in good, soft soil.

label: ITEMINFO_449
text: A case for storing Poffins cooked from Berries.

label: ITEMINFO_450
text:
A folding bike that enables a rider to get around
much faster than with Running Shoes.

label: ITEMINFO_451
text:
A key to one of the suites at a certain luxury hotel
by a lake. For some odd reason, it often disappears.

label: ITEMINFO_452
text:
A letter from Professor Oak. Written in it is a
request for you to go to Route 224.

label: ITEMINFO_453
text:
A feather that glows like the moon. It’s said to
possess the power to dispel nightmares.

label: ITEMINFO_454
text:
A card needed for entering the inn in Canalave City.
Oddly, the last date marked on it was
50 years ago.

label: ITEMINFO_455
text:
A flute that puts out echoing sounds that do not
seem to be of this world. No one knows who
made it.

label: ITEMINFO_456
text:
A ticket required for sailing on the ferry S.S. Aqua.
It has a drawing of a ship on its front.

label: ITEMINFO_457
text:
A pass required for entering Pokémon Contests.
It has a drawing of an award ribbon on its front.

label: ITEMINFO_458
text:
A stone formed by boulders melting in intensely hot
magma, then hardening. Magma remains sealed
inside it.

label: ITEMINFO_459
text:
A parcel entrusted into your care. You’re supposed
to deliver it to your childhood friend who left
Twinleaf Town.

label: ITEMINFO_460
text:
A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch—
Pokétch for short. Three coupons are needed.

label: ITEMINFO_461
text:
A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch—
Pokétch for short. Three coupons are needed.

label: ITEMINFO_462
text:
A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch—
Pokétch for short. Three coupons are needed.

label: ITEMINFO_463
text:
The key to Team Galactic’s sinister warehouse
located at the edge of Veilstone City.

label: ITEMINFO_464
text:
A fantastic medicine dispensed by the pharmacy in
Cianwood City. It fully heals a Pokémon of
any ailment.

label: ITEMINFO_465
text:
An amazing device that can record a battle
between friends or the battles at certain special
battle facilities.

label: ITEMINFO_466
text:
A flower sometimes bundled in bouquets to convey
gratitude on special occasions, such as birthdays.

label: ITEMINFO_467
text:
A high-tech key that has to be used at a specific
location. It emits a special electronic signal to open
a door.

label: ITEMINFO_468
text:
A handy box where you can store up to 99 of each
kind of Apricorn.

label: ITEMINFO_469
text: A report detailing all of the discovered kinds of Unown.

label: ITEMINFO_470
text:
Handy containers for cultivating Berries wherever
you go.

label: ITEMINFO_471
text:
A high-tech machine that shows the location of
invisible items. It’s attached to the head when
in use.

label: ITEMINFO_472
text: A card to save points for the Buena’s Password show.

label: ITEMINFO_473
text:
A very tasty tail of something. It can be sold at a high
price to shops.

label: ITEMINFO_474
text:
A very old-fashioned bell that makes a gentle
ringing sound.

label: ITEMINFO_475
text: A card key that opens a shutter in the Radio Tower.

label: ITEMINFO_476
text: A key that opens a door in the Goldenrod Tunnel.

label: ITEMINFO_477
text: A bottle used for watering plants in the Berry Pots.

label: ITEMINFO_478
text:
A scale from a red Gyarados. It glows red like
a flame.

label: ITEMINFO_479
text: The Mime Jr. doll that was lost by the Copycat.

label: ITEMINFO_480
text:
A pass required for riding the Magnet Train. It allows
you to ride whenever and however much you’d like.

label: ITEMINFO_481
text:
An important part of a machine that was stolen from the
Power Plant.

label: ITEMINFO_482
text: A strange, silvery feather that sparkles.

label: ITEMINFO_483
text: A mystical rainbow feather that sparkles.

label: ITEMINFO_484
text:
A mysterious Egg obtained from Mr. Pokémon.
What is in the Egg is unknown.

label: ITEMINFO_485
text: A red Apricorn. It assails your nostrils.

label: ITEMINFO_486
text: A blue Apricorn. It smells a bit like grass.

label: ITEMINFO_487
text: A yellow Apricorn. It has an invigorating scent.

label: ITEMINFO_488
text:
A green Apricorn. It has a mysterious,
aromatic scent.

label: ITEMINFO_489
text: A pink Apricorn. It has a nice, sweet scent.

label: ITEMINFO_1579
text:
Honey that Dynamax Vespiquen produces. Adding this
honey to Max Soup makes the taste very smooth. It also
has the same effect as a Max Revive.

label: ITEMINFO_1580
text:
Mushrooms that have the power of changing Dynamax
forms. They boost all stats of a Pokémon during battle.

label: ITEMINFO_1581
text:
A twig from a species of tree called Galarica that grows
in certain areas around the Galar region. It’s a material
for an accessory for a certain Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_1582
text:
A cuff made from woven-together Galarica Twigs.
Giving it to Galarian Slowpoke makes the
Pokémon very happy.

label: ITEMINFO_1583
text:
A card that increases the selection in boutiques and
hair salons.

label: ITEMINFO_1584
text:
A pass to go to the Isle of Armor. Show it to the rail
staff at Wedgehurst Station.

label: ITEMINFO_1585
text:
This bike can do a turbo boost and run on the water
using Rotom’s power. It’s a sparkling white that
shines brilliantly.

label: ITEMINFO_1586
text:
This bike can do a turbo boost and run on the water
using Rotom’s power. It’s a glistening black that
shines reddish-black.

label: ITEMINFO_1587
text:
A charm that increases the Exp. Points that Pokémon
can get. A machine-like object is inside the charm.

label: ITEMINFO_1588
text:
Rare ore that can be obtained on the Isle of Armor.
Something good will happen if you give it to a collector
on the Isle of Armor.

label: ITEMINFO_1589
text:
A mysterious and unique charm that increases the
chance of finding a Pokémon with a mark.

label: ITEMINFO_1590
text:
Reins that people presented to the king. They enhance
Calyrex’s power over bountiful harvests and unite
Calyrex with its beloved steed.

label: ITEMINFO_1591
text:
Reins that people presented to the king. They enable
those who are connected to communicate with each
other. The reins separate Calyrex and its beloved steed.

label: ITEMINFO_1592
text:
A wreath made from woven-together Galarica Twigs.
Placing it on the head of a Galarian Slowpoke makes
the Pokémon very happy.

label: ITEMINFO_1593
text:
A clue about the King of Bountiful Harvests. It’s written
by Peony, and an old photo is attached to it.

label: ITEMINFO_1594
text:
A clue about the legend of giants. It’s written
by Peony and has unique drawings.

label: ITEMINFO_1595
text:
A clue about the legend of bird Pokémon. It’s written
by Peony and has a unique drawing.

label: ITEMINFO_1596
text:
A mysterious clue that Peony seems to have dropped.
There’s a photo attached to it showing a shining hole
opening above the Max Lair.

label: ITEMINFO_1597
text:
A pass to go to the Crown Tundra. Show it to the rail
staff at Wedgehurst Station.

label: ITEMINFO_1598
text:
A mysterious object made of wood. Part of it seems to
be chipped. Maybe it’s meant to be part of something.

label: ITEMINFO_1599
text:
A single petal that the King of Bountiful Harvests
gave you. It radiates faint light.

label: ITEMINFO_1600
text:
Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful
Harvests’ beloved steed, Glastrier. The hair is strong
and very flexible.

label: ITEMINFO_1601
text:
Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful
Harvests’ beloved steed, Spectrier. The hair is very
smooth to the touch.

label: ITEMINFO_1602
text:
Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved
steed likes to eat. It grew in a field covered in snow.

label: ITEMINFO_1603
text:
Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved
steed likes to eat. It grew in a gloomy field.

label: ITEMINFO_1604
text:
Mysterious ore that can be obtained in the Max Lair.
Something good will happen if you give it to a
collector in the Crown Tundra.

label: ITEMINFO_1605
text:
Seeds to plant in a field. The kind of carrot you’ll get is
determined by which field you plant the seeds in.

label: ITEMINFO_1606
text:
A patch that allows a Pokémon with a regular Ability
to have a rare Ability.

label: ITEMINFO_1607
text:
Cords that shine when you hold them up to the light.
The people of old times presented these to the King of
Bountiful Harvests to express their gratitude.

label: ITEMINFO_1608
text:
A small shard that emanates an enigmatic power.
Inside the shard, you can see a pattern that looks like
Ramanas roses.

label: ITEMINFO_1609

A large shard that emanates an enigmatic power.
Inside the shard, you can see a pattern that looks like
Ramanas roses.

label: ITEMINFO_1610

A single-use drill to bore a hole in the wall for your
Secret Base.

label: ITEMINFO_001
text:
The best Poké Ball with the ultimate level of
performance. With it, you will catch any wild
Pokémon without fail.

label: ITEMINFO_002
text:
An ultra-high-performance Poké Ball that provides
a higher success rate for catching Pokémon than
a Great Ball.

label: ITEMINFO_003
text:
A good, high-performance Poké Ball that provides
a higher success rate for catching Pokémon than
a standard Poké Ball.

label: ITEMINFO_004
text:
A device for catching wild Pokémon. It’s thrown like
a ball at a Pokémon, comfortably encapsulating
its target.

label: ITEMINFO_006
text:
A somewhat different Poké Ball that is more
effective when attempting to catch Water- or
Bug-type Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_007
text:
A somewhat different Poké Ball that works
especially well when catching Pokémon that
live underwater.

label: ITEMINFO_008
text:
A somewhat different Poké Ball that becomes more
effective the lower the level of the wild Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_009
text:
A somewhat different Poké Ball that works
especially well on a Pokémon species that has been
caught before.

label: ITEMINFO_010
text:

label: ITEMINFO_1880

An item to be held by Pokémon with certain Abilities.
The energy that fills this capsule boosts the strength of
the Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_1881
text:
An item to be held by a Pokémon. This cute and rather
unique-looking shield protects the holder from having its
Ability changed by others.

label: ITEMINFO_1882
text:
An item to be held by a Pokémon. This clear, sparkling
amulet protects the holder from having its stats lowered
by moves used against it or by other Pokémon’s Abilities.

label: ITEMINFO_1883
text:
An item to be held by a Pokémon. This herb will allow
the holder to mirror an opponent’s stat increases to
boost its own stats—but only once.

label: ITEMINFO_1884
text:
An item to be held by a Pokémon. This protective glove
boosts the power of the holder’s punching moves and
prevents direct contact with targets.

label: ITEMINFO_1885
text:
An item to be held by a Pokémon. This hooded cloak
conceals the holder, tricking the eyes of its enemies
and protecting it from the additional effects of moves.

label: ITEMINFO_1886
text:
An item to be held by a Pokémon. This loaded dice
always rolls a good number, and holding one can ensure
that the holder’s multistrike moves hit more times.

label: ITEMINFO_1888
text:
A long loaf sliced into top and bottom halves. Its aroma
of wheat and its straightforward, salty flavor make it pair
well with all kinds of sandwich ingredients.

label: ITEMINFO_1889
text:
A condiment that packs a very tart punch yet pairs well
with various ingredients.

label: ITEMINFO_1890
text:
A condiment with very salty and tart flavor. While a
number of other ingredients go into its signature flavor,
the noble tomato is its heart and soul.

label: ITEMINFO_1891
text:
A very spicy condiment that’s indispensable when bread
is on the table. It pairs tremendously with ketchup.

label: ITEMINFO_1892
text:
A condiment that unites salty and sweet and also packs a
richness that makes bread a delight to eat. The finest
butter products are made of 100 percent Moomoo Milk.

label: ITEMINFO_1893
text:
A very sweet condiment. People in Paldea seem to favor
the sweet varieties over the unsweetened.

label: ITEMINFO_1894
text:
A condiment with a very spicy kick. It’s thanks to
Scovillain that this sauce gets its signature mouth-
tingling burn.

label: ITEMINFO_1895
text:
A very salty seasoning, unsurprisingly. People quite
like the grains of salt that can be gathered from the
footprints of particularly jagged Naclstack.

label: ITEMINFO_1896
text:
A seasoning packing very spicy flavor. It goes nicely
with oilier foods and works especially well when you
add just a pinch for a hint of flavor.

label: ITEMINFO_1897
text:
A condiment that’s very sweet and very sour. It goes
especially well with fruit and is easy to incorporate into
a sandwich.

label: ITEMINFO_1898
text:
A very sweet condiment. Folks in Paldea seem to love
the varieties that really let the sweetness sing.

label: ITEMINFO_1899
text:
A condiment offering very sweet and very tart flavor.
It goes well with more ingredients than you’d expect,
making it a convenient go-to.

label: ITEMINFO_1900
text:
A condiment that’s very sweet and likewise very sour.
Take care when adding it to sandwiches, as the sweet
side can overwhelm.

label: ITEMINFO_1901
text:
A condiment with sour and bitter notes. It’s surprisingly
useful, as it makes a nice counterpoint to oilier foods.

label: ITEMINFO_1902
text:
A condiment offering faint notes of sour and bitter
flavors. The most prized varieties are the ones Smoliv
love the smell of—such oils’ quality is assured.

label: ITEMINFO_1903
text:
A very sour condiment. Vinegars derived from grapes are
popular in Paldea. Highly effective when used to add
just a light note of flavor.

label: ITEMINFO_1904
text:
A legendary condiment told of only in books. Word has
it that one taste of its sweet flavor stimulates the
digestive system and cures a lack of appetite.

label: ITEMINFO_1905
text:
One of the condiments spoken of as legends. Its mellow
saltiness is said to be tremendously effective when it
comes to promoting health.

label: ITEMINFO_1906
text:
This surpassingly sour condiment is said to be super
effective in helping the eater recover from exhaustion.
Only a scant few people know it exists.

label: ITEMINFO_1907
text:
A legendary condiment with a deeply bitter taste. It’s
said to dramatically bolster a body’s immune defenses,
though that hasn’t been proven.

label: ITEMINFO_1908
text:
The legendary condiment said to have the mightiest of
all spicy flavors. It’s said that a single bite will kick the
metabolism into high gear immediately.

label: ITEMINFO_1909
text:
This bitter-tasting ingredient is simple and
straightforward—just add it to all kinds of other
ingredients for a delightfully crunchy time.

label: ITEMINFO_1910
text:
This very tart ingredient has a lot of savory elements
to it, making it popular with many Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_1911
text:
A very tart ingredient. Some varieties are also very
sweet, and these are prized above all others by the
people of Paldea.

label: ITEMINFO_1912
text:
A tart and bitter ingredient. Using it together with rich-
tasting ingredients in a sandwich will really make the
most of a cucumber’s fresh-veggie aroma.

label: ITEMINFO_1913
text:
This very sour ingredient is made by pickling veggies
in a flavorful brine made from spices and vinegar.

label: ITEMINFO_1914
text:
This spicy veggie is indispensable to many sandwiches.
It goes well with rich ingredients.

label: ITEMINFO_1915
text:
An ingredient with some sweetness to it. Its spiciness and
fragrance are milder than those of other onions, making
it a pleasant bite.

label: ITEMINFO_1916
text:
An ingredient with some bitterness. When sliced, it adds
a nice accent to a sandwich.

label: ITEMINFO_1917
text:
An ingredient with some bitterness—but its bitter notes
and overall flavor are pleasantly mild compared to its
green cousin.

label: ITEMINFO_1918
text:
An ingredient with some bitterness. It’s not much
different from its red counterpart in flavor, but mixing
the colors makes a feast for the eyes.

label: ITEMINFO_1919
text:
An ingredient with sweet notes—though its flavor is
very mild. The avocado’s richness, however, makes it
satisfying to eat.

label: ITEMINFO_1920
text:
This very salty ingredient has been cooked just shy of
charred, making it burst with fragrance and tasty flavor.

label: ITEMINFO_1921
text:
A very salty ingredient—and that very saltiness is what
makes it such a nice companion to veggies.

label: ITEMINFO_1922
text:
This ingredient is very salty like regular ham, but the
difference is prosciutto is not cooked after it is cured,
giving it a fun freshness.

label: ITEMINFO_1923
text:
A very salty and spicy ingredient. This type of sausage
has particularly robust salty flavor, and the spicier
varieties are extra popular.

label: ITEMINFO_1924
text:
A very salty and bitter ingredient. The balance between
the potent saltiness and the herbs’ bitterness make this
sausage a pleasure.

label: ITEMINFO_1925
text:
This very salty ingredient is the thing to add if you want
to make your sandwich truly filling.

label: ITEMINFO_1926
text:
A very sweet and salty ingredient. It’s a nutritious
processed food made with a concentrate derived from
shed Klawf shells.

label: ITEMINFO_1927
text:
A very salty and bitter ingredient with that unmistakable
smoky flavor. It pairs exceptionally well with veggies.

label: ITEMINFO_1928
text:
When used in a sandwich, this very salty and bitter
ingredient is at its best paired with sour seasonings.

label: ITEMINFO_1929
text:
An ingredient with a touch of saltiness. It’s full of
nutrients and can be enjoyed with all sorts of seasonings.

label: ITEMINFO_1930
text:
A very salty ingredient and a popular dish in Paldea.
It’s undeniably filling.

label: ITEMINFO_1931
text:
An ingredient with a touch of sweetness. It’s unclear how
well this raw block of tofu will serve as a sandwich filling.

label: ITEMINFO_1932
text:
An ingredient with a touch of sweetness. It’s unclear how
well this cooked rice will serve as a sandwich filling.

label: ITEMINFO_1933
text:
A nice salty ingredient. It’s unclear how well these boiled
noodles will serve as a sandwich filling.

label: ITEMINFO_1934
text:
This very tart ingredient—a soft salad that’s all about
potatoes—pairs tremendously well with bread.

label: ITEMINFO_1935
text:
A very salty ingredient. This thinly sliced cheese is
perfect for adding to a sandwich.

label: ITEMINFO_1936
text:
A very sweet ingredient. This go-to fruit is sweet and
rich, and it’s beloved by many Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_1937
text:
A very tart and sweet ingredient, popular for its ability
to make a sandwich visually striking.

label: ITEMINFO_1938
text:
This very sweet ingredient is sliced thin to make it easy
to add into a sandwich.

label: ITEMINFO_1939
text:
A very tart ingredient that has a light touch of sweetness
as well. It goes well with rich ingredients.

label: ITEMINFO_1940
text:
This very tart ingredient is a fruit of southern lands,
and its color and texture are a thrill. It’s been cut into
chunks to be easily manageable.

label: ITEMINFO_1941
text:
A very spicy ingredient—so spicy as to leave no room
for ambivalence about it. You either like it or you don’t.

label: ITEMINFO_1942
text:
A very spicy condiment. Its distinctive sharp sizzle in
your sinuses makes it a good match for rich fillings.

label: ITEMINFO_1943
text:
A very spicy condiment. Just watch out—use too much
of this potent seasoning, and it’ll cancel out the other
flavors.

label: ITEMINFO_1944
text:
This very spicy condiment seems close to horseradish at
first, but you’ll find that it has a superb flavor all its own.

label: ITEMINFO_1945
text:
A very bitter ingredient that stands out among veggies
for its quirky flavor. People tend to either like it or not
like it—they rarely sit on the fence.

label: ITEMINFO_1946
text:
A very bitter ingredient that’s quite versatile, as herbs
go. It’s fragrant and goes well with tomatoes.

This sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

label: ITEMINFO_1131
text:
The user drops onto the target with its full body
weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

label: ITEMINFO_1132
text:
The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire.
This may also leave the target with a burn.

label: ITEMINFO_1133
text:
The target is blasted by a huge volume of water
launched under great pressure.

label: ITEMINFO_1134
text:
The user attacks everything around it by swamping
its surroundings with a giant wave.

label: ITEMINFO_1135
text:
The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy.
This may also leave the target frozen.

label: ITEMINFO_1136
text:
A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing
Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing
Pokémon frozen.

label: ITEMINFO_1137
text:
A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over.
The heavier the target, the greater the move’s power.

label: ITEMINFO_1138
text:
A strong electric blast crashes down on the target.
This may also leave the target with paralysis.

label: ITEMINFO_1139
text:
A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to
inflict damage. This may also leave the target
with paralysis.

label: ITEMINFO_1140
text:
The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every
Pokémon around it.

label: ITEMINFO_1141
text:
The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force.
This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

label: ITEMINFO_1142
text:
The user relaxes and lightens its body to move
faster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

label: ITEMINFO_1143
text:
The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that
critical hits land more easily.

label: ITEMINFO_1144
text:
The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain
into randomly using nearly any move.

label: ITEMINFO_1145
text:
The target is attacked with an intense blast of
all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target
with a burn.

label: ITEMINFO_1146
text:
The user charges at the target and may make
it flinch.

label: ITEMINFO_1147
text:
The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its
concerns. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

label: ITEMINFO_1148
text:
The user drains the target’s blood. The user’s HP is
restored by half the damage taken by the target.

label: ITEMINFO_1149
text:
The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack.
This may also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

label: ITEMINFO_1150
text:
The user creates a substitute for itself using some of
its own HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

label: ITEMINFO_1151
text:
An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the
less HP the user has.

label: ITEMINFO_1152
text:
Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may
also poison the target.

label: ITEMINFO_1153
text:
The user lays a trap of spikes at the opposing
team’s feet. The trap hurts Pokémon that switch
into battle.

label: ITEMINFO_1154
text:
The user rampages and attacks for two to three
turns. The user then becomes confused.

label: ITEMINFO_1155
text:
The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack
the target. This attack does physical damage.

label: ITEMINFO_1156
text:
The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP.
Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

label: ITEMINFO_1157
text:

Honey that Dynamax Vespiquen produces. Adding this
honey to Max Soup makes the taste very smooth. It also
has the same effect as a Max Revive.

text:

forms. They boost all stats of a Pokémon during battle.

label: ITEMINFO_1581

A twig from a species of tree called Galarica that grows
in certain areas around the Galar region. It’s a material
for an accessory for a certain Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_1582
text:
A cuff made from woven-together Galarica Twigs.
Giving it to a Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokémon
very happy.

label: ITEMINFO_1583

available to you in boutiques and hair salons.

shines brilliantly.

text:

text:
Having one of these charms increases the Exp. Points
your Pokémon get. A machine-like object is inside it.

label: ITEMINFO_1588
text:
Rare ore that can be obtained on the Isle of Armor.
Something good will happen if you give it to a collector
on the Isle of Armor.

label: ITEMINFO_1589
text:
Having one of these mysterious and unique charms
makes it more likely you’ll encounter a Pokémon with
a mark.

label: ITEMINFO_1590
text:
Reins that people presented to the king. They enhance
Calyrex’s power over bountiful harvests and unite
Calyrex with its beloved steed.

text:
Reins that people presented to the king. They enable
those who are connected to communicate with each
other. The reins separate Calyrex and its beloved steed.

label: ITEMINFO_1592
text:
A wreath made from woven-together Galarica Twigs.
Placing it on the head of a Galarian Slowpoke makes
the Pokémon very happy.

label: ITEMINFO_1593
text:
A clue about the King of Bountiful Harvests. It’s written
by Peony, and an old photo is attached to it.

label: ITEMINFO_1594
text:
A clue about the legend of giants. It’s written
by Peony and has unique drawings.

label: ITEMINFO_1595
text:
A clue about the legend of bird Pokémon. It’s written
by Peony and has a unique drawing.

label: ITEMINFO_1596
text:
A mysterious clue that Peony seems to have dropped.
There’s a photo attached to it showing a shining hole
opening above the Max Lair.

label: ITEMINFO_1597
text:
A pass to go to the Crown Tundra. Show it to the rail
staff at Wedgehurst Station.

label: ITEMINFO_1598
text:
A mysterious object made of wood. Part of it seems to
be chipped. Maybe it’s meant to be part of something.

label: ITEMINFO_1599
text:
A single petal that the King of Bountiful Harvests
gave you. It radiates faint light.

label: ITEMINFO_1600
text:
Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful
Harvests’ beloved steed, Glastrier. The hair is strong
and very flexible.

label: ITEMINFO_1601

Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful
Harvests’ beloved steed, Spectrier. The hair is very
smooth to the touch.

label: ITEMINFO_1602

steed likes to eat. It grew in a field covered in snow.

label: ITEMINFO_1603

steed likes to eat. It grew in a gloomy field.

label: ITEMINFO_1604

Something good will happen if you give it to a
collector in the Crown Tundra.

label: ITEMINFO_1605

Seeds to plant in a field. The kind of carrot you’ll get is
determined by which field you plant the seeds in.

label: ITEMINFO_1606

A patch that can be used to change the regular Ability
of a Pokémon to a rarer Ability.

label: ITEMINFO_1607

Cords that shine when you hold them up to the light.
The people of old times presented these to the King of
Bountiful Harvests to express their gratitude.

label: ITEMINFO_001
text:
The very best Poké Ball with the ultimate level of
performance. With it, you will catch any wild Pokémon
without fail.

label: ITEMINFO_002
text:
An ultra-high-performance Poké Ball that provides a
higher success rate for catching Pokémon than a
Great Ball.

label: ITEMINFO_003
text:
A good, high-performance Poké Ball that provides a
higher success rate for catching Pokémon than a
standard Poké Ball.

label: ITEMINFO_004
text:
A device for catching wild Pokémon. It’s thrown like a ball
at a Pokémon, comfortably encapsulating its target.

label: ITEMINFO_005
text:
A special Poké Ball used in locales such as the Safari
Zone in the Kanto region and the Great Marsh in the
Sinnoh region.

label: ITEMINFO_006
text:
A somewhat different Poké Ball that is more effective
when catching Water- or Bug-type Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_007
text:
A somewhat different Poké Ball that is more effective
when catching Pokémon in or on the water.

label: ITEMINFO_008
text:
A somewhat different Poké Ball that becomes more
effective the lower the level of the wild Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_009
text:
A somewhat different Poké Ball that is more effective
when catching a Pokémon of a species that you’ve
caught before.

label: ITEMINFO_010
text:
A somewhat different Poké Ball that becomes more
effective at catching a Pokémon the more actions the
target has taken.

label: ITEMINFO_011
text:
A particularly comfortable Poké Ball that makes a wild
Pokémon quickly grow friendlier after being caught.

label: ITEMINFO_012
text:
A somewhat rare Poké Ball made to commemorate a
special occasion of some sort.

label: ITEMINFO_013
text:
A somewhat different Poké Ball that is more effective
when catching Pokémon at night.

label: ITEMINFO_014
text:
A remedial Poké Ball that restores HP and eliminates
status conditions for a Pokémon caught with it.

label: ITEMINFO_015
text:
A somewhat different Poké Ball that is more effective at
catching Pokémon if it is used before they spot you.

label: ITEMINFO_016
text:
A quite rare Poké Ball made to commemorate a special
occasion of some sort.

to restore 20 HP to a Pokémon.

text:

used to lift the effects of being poisoned from a
Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_019
text:
A spray-type medicine for treating burns. It can be used
to cure a Pokémon suffering from a burn.

text:

label: ITEMINFO_1099

really enhance a dish.

the holder from the effects of traps and the like set on
the battlefield.

protects the holder from the effects of rain and harsh
sunlight.

text:
A candy that is packed with energy. If consumed, it raises
the Dynamax Level of a Pokémon by one. A higher level
means higher HP when Dynamaxed.

label: ITEMINFO_1130
text:
A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit.
This sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

label: ITEMINFO_1131
text:
The user drops onto the target with its full body
weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

label: ITEMINFO_1132
text:
The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire.
This may also leave the target with a burn.

label: ITEMINFO_1133
text:
The target is blasted by a huge volume of water
launched under great pressure.

label: ITEMINFO_1134
text:
The user attacks everything around it by swamping
its surroundings with a giant wave.

label: ITEMINFO_1135
text:
The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy.
This may also leave the target frozen.

label: ITEMINFO_1136
text:
A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing
Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing
Pokémon frozen.

label: ITEMINFO_1137
text:
A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over.
The heavier the target, the greater the move’s power.

label: ITEMINFO_1138
text:
A strong electric blast crashes down on the target.
This may also leave the target with paralysis.

label: ITEMINFO_1139
text:
A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to
inflict damage. This may also leave the target
with paralysis.

label: ITEMINFO_1140
text:
The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every
Pokémon around it.

label: ITEMINFO_1141
text:
The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force.
This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

label: ITEMINFO_1142
text:
The user relaxes and lightens its body to move
faster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

label: ITEMINFO_1143
text:
The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that
critical hits land more easily.

label: ITEMINFO_1144
text:
The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain
into randomly using nearly any move.

label: ITEMINFO_1145
text:
The target is attacked with an intense blast of
all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target
with a burn.

label: ITEMINFO_1146
text:
The user charges at the target and may make
it flinch.

label: ITEMINFO_1147
text:
The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its
concerns. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

label: ITEMINFO_1148
text:
The user drains the target’s blood. The user’s HP is
restored by half the damage taken by the target.

label: ITEMINFO_1149
text:
The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack.
This may also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

label: ITEMINFO_1150
text:
The user creates a substitute for itself using some of
its own HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

label: ITEMINFO_1151
text:
An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the
less HP the user has.

label: ITEMINFO_1152
text:
Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may
also poison the target.

label: ITEMINFO_1153
text:
The user lays a trap of spikes at the opposing
team’s feet. The trap hurts Pokémon that switch
into battle.

label: ITEMINFO_1154
text:
The user rampages and attacks for two to three
turns. The user then becomes confused.

label: ITEMINFO_1155
text:
The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack
the target. This attack does physical damage.

label: ITEMINFO_1156
text:
The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP.
Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

label: ITEMINFO_1157
text:
While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the
moves it knows.

label: ITEMINFO_1158
text:
Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams
into the target with no letup.

label: ITEMINFO_1159
text:
The user switches places with a party Pokémon in
waiting and passes along any stat changes.

label: ITEMINFO_1160
text:
The user compels the target to keep using the move
it encored for three turns.

label: ITEMINFO_1161
text:
The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail.
This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

label: ITEMINFO_1162
text:
The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs.
This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

label: ITEMINFO_1163
text:
The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target.
This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

label: ITEMINFO_1164
text:
Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic
energy attacks the target.

label: ITEMINFO_1165
text:
The user attacks in an uproar for three turns.
During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

label: ITEMINFO_1166
text:
The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing
Pokémon. This may also leave those Pokémon with
a burn.

label: ITEMINFO_1167
text:
The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use
only attack moves for three turns.

label: ITEMINFO_1168
text:
The user catches the target off guard and swaps its
held item with its own.

label: ITEMINFO_1169
text:
The user attacks the target with great power.
However, this also lowers the user’s Attack and
Defense stats.

label: ITEMINFO_1170
text:
The user employs its psychic power to exchange
Abilities with the target.

label: ITEMINFO_1171
text:
The user launches a kick that lands a critical hit
more easily. This may also leave the target with
a burn.

label: ITEMINFO_1172
text:
The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with
the power to inflict damage.

label: ITEMINFO_1173
text:
The user attacks the target at full power. The attack’s
recoil harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

label: ITEMINFO_1174
text:
The user absorbs a mystical power from space to
raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

label: ITEMINFO_1175
text:
The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing
Pokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.

label: ITEMINFO_1176
text:
The user hardens its body’s surface like iron,
sharply raising its Defense stat.

label: ITEMINFO_1177
text: The user slashes the target with huge sharp claws.

label: ITEMINFO_1178
text:
The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body,
raising both its Attack and Defense stats.

label: ITEMINFO_1179
text:
The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its
spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

label: ITEMINFO_1180
text:
The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and
attacks by cutting its target. Critical hits land
more easily.

label: ITEMINFO_1181
text:
The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful
dance that raises its Attack and Speed stats.

label: ITEMINFO_1182
text:
The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin.
The slower the user compared to the target, the
greater the move’s power.

label: ITEMINFO_1183
text:
The user fights the target up close without guarding
itself. This also lowers the user’s Defense and
Sp. Def stats.

label: ITEMINFO_1184
text:
The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of
the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing
Pokémon that switch into battle.

label: ITEMINFO_1185
text:
The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target.
This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack
may leave the target with a burn.

label: ITEMINFO_1186
text:
The user lets loose a blast of aura power from deep
within its body at the target. This attack
never misses.

label: ITEMINFO_1187
text:
The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like
steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

label: ITEMINFO_1188
text:
The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark
thoughts. This may also make the target flinch.

label: ITEMINFO_1189
text:

label: ITEMINFO_1579
text:
Honey that Dynamax Vespiquen produces. Adding this
honey to Max Soup makes the taste very smooth. It also
has the same effect as a Max Revive.

label: ITEMINFO_1580
text:
Mushrooms that have the power of changing Dynamax
forms. They boost all stats of a Pokémon during battle.

label: ITEMINFO_1581
text:
A twig from a species of tree called Galarica that grows
in certain areas around the Galar region. It’s a material
for an accessory for a certain Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_1582
text:
A cuff made from woven-together Galarica Twigs.
Giving it to a Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokémon
very happy.

label: ITEMINFO_1583
text:
Having one of these cards increases the selection
available to you in boutiques and hair salons.

label: ITEMINFO_1584
text:
A pass to go to the Isle of Armor. Show it to the rail
staff at Wedgehurst Station.

label: ITEMINFO_1585
text:
This bike can do a turbo boost and run on the water
using Rotom’s power. It’s a sparkling white that
shines brilliantly.

label: ITEMINFO_1586
text:
This bike can do a turbo boost and run on the water
using Rotom’s power. It’s a glistening black that
shines reddish-black.

label: ITEMINFO_1587
text:
Having one of these charms increases the Exp. Points
your Pokémon get. It’s a strange, stretchy charm that
encourages growth.

label: ITEMINFO_1588
text:
Rare ore that can be obtained on the Isle of Armor.
Something good will happen if you give it to a collector
on the Isle of Armor.

label: ITEMINFO_1589
text:
Having one of these mysterious and unique charms
makes it more likely you’ll encounter a Pokémon with
a mark.

label: ITEMINFO_1590
text:
Reins that people presented to the king. They enhance
Calyrex’s power over bountiful harvests and unite
Calyrex with its beloved steed.

label: ITEMINFO_1591
text:
Reins that people presented to the king. They enable
those who are connected to communicate with each
other. The reins separate Calyrex and its beloved steed.

label: ITEMINFO_1592
text:
A wreath made from woven-together Galarica Twigs.
Placing it on the head of a Galarian Slowpoke makes the
Pokémon very happy.

label: ITEMINFO_1593
text:
A clue about the King of Bountiful Harvests. It’s written
by Peony, and an old photo is attached to it.

label: ITEMINFO_1594
text:
A clue about the legend of giants. It’s written
by Peony and has unique drawings.

label: ITEMINFO_1595
text:
A clue about the legend of bird Pokémon. It’s written
by Peony and has a unique drawing.

label: ITEMINFO_1596
text:
A mysterious clue that Peony seems to have dropped.
There’s a photo attached to it showing a shining hole
opening above the Max Lair.

label: ITEMINFO_1597
text:
A pass to go to the Crown Tundra. Show it to the rail
staff at Wedgehurst Station.

label: ITEMINFO_1598
text:
A mysterious object made of wood. Part of it seems to
be chipped. Maybe it’s meant to be part of something.

label: ITEMINFO_1599
text:
A single petal that the King of Bountiful Harvests
gave you. It radiates faint light.

label: ITEMINFO_1600
text:
Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful
Harvests’ beloved steed, Glastrier. The hair is strong
and very flexible.

label: ITEMINFO_1601
text:
Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful
Harvests’ beloved steed, Spectrier. The hair is very
smooth to the touch.

label: ITEMINFO_1602
text:
Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved
steed likes to eat. It grew in a field covered in snow.

label: ITEMINFO_1603
text:
Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved
steed likes to eat. It grew in a gloomy field.

label: ITEMINFO_1604
text:
Mysterious ore that can be obtained in the Max Lair.
Something good will happen if you give it to a
collector in the Crown Tundra.

label: ITEMINFO_1605
text:
Seeds to plant in a field. The kind of carrot you’ll get is
determined by which field you plant the seeds in.

label: ITEMINFO_1606
text:
A patch that can be used to change the regular Ability
of a Pokémon to a rarer Ability.

label: ITEMINFO_1607
text:
Cords that shine when you hold them up to the light.
The people of old times presented these to the King of
Bountiful Harvests to express their gratitude.

label: ITEMINFO_1608
text:
A mysterious balm that somehow has the power to calm
Dialga in its frenzy.

label: ITEMINFO_1609
text:
A mysterious balm that somehow has the power to calm
Palkia in its frenzy.

label: ITEMINFO_1610
text: A mysterious balm to be used when battling Arceus.

label: ITEMINFO_1611
text:
A string exuding a mysterious energy that makes you
feel a strange sense of connection. It’s loved by
certain Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_1612
text:
A baked treat made from Berries and other ingredients,
which is often eaten in regions such as Galar. It is
beloved by a surprising number of Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_1613
text:
A fruit whose shell can be used to form the capsules of
all manner of Poké Balls when crafting them from
scratch. Its proper name is actually “Brown Apricorn.”

label: ITEMINFO_1614
text:
A hidden gem gaining popularity in Jubilife Village and
beloved by Pokémon. This sweet treat can be fed to
a Pokémon to cure any status condition it may have.

label: ITEMINFO_1615
text:
An item that sharply boosts the offensive and defensive
stats of a Pokémon in battle. These effects disappear
if the Pokémon leaves the battle.

label: ITEMINFO_1616
text:
An item that sharply boosts the critical-hit ratio of
a Pokémon in battle. This effect disappears if the
Pokémon leaves the battle.

label: ITEMINFO_1617
text:
A dumpling that will make a Pokémon become fixated on
a move in battle. The Pokémon will deal more damage
when using that move but will take more damage as well.

label: ITEMINFO_1618
text:
These pickled vegetables prime a Pokémon for battle.
The Pokémon takes a hard-hitting stance, which boosts
the damage dealt by its moves by 50 percent.

label: ITEMINFO_1619
text:
When eaten, this curious snack temporarily swaps a
Pokémon’s offensive stats with its defensive stats.

label: ITEMINFO_1620
text:
A fern used for crafting items made to be thrown.
When these curled leaves are unfurled, they can serve
as nature’s wrapping paper.

label: ITEMINFO_1621
text:
A rare seed that can be given to the captain of the
Security Corps to have a Pokémon master a move
so it can be used in the agile style or strong style.

label: ITEMINFO_1624
text:
A type of ice beloved by the Lord of the Tundra,
Avalugg. This ice is said to be fragments of ancient
Avalugg that lived long ago.

label: ITEMINFO_1625
text:
Proof that you have completed the trial set by Uxie,
the Being of Knowledge that lives in Lake Acuity.
This item is needed to forge the Red Chain.

label: ITEMINFO_1626
text:
Proof that you have completed the trial set by Azelf,
the Being of Willpower that lives in Lake Valor.
This item is needed to forge the Red Chain.

label: ITEMINFO_1627
text:
Proof that you have completed the trial set by Mesprit,
the Being of Emotion that lives in Lake Verity.
This item is needed to forge the Red Chain.

label: ITEMINFO_1628
text:
When combined with an Apricorn, this mysterious
tumbled stone can draw out the properties required
to forge a Poké Ball.

label: ITEMINFO_1629
text:
A flute that can be used to call special Pokémon that
are willing to bear you around the region. Its timbre is
eerie and mysterious.

label: ITEMINFO_1630
text:
An herbal medicine that can restore 60 HP to a
Pokémon, just as a Potion does. Yet the bitter taste
will make the Pokémon less friendly toward you.

label: ITEMINFO_1631
text:
An herbal medicine that can restore 100 HP to a
Pokémon, just as a Super Potion does. Yet the bitter taste
will make the Pokémon less friendly toward you.

label: ITEMINFO_1632
text:
Honey that sparkles with an amber hue. It is beloved
by bug Pokémon and Pokémon with fairylike charms,
so they will gather wherever a comb of it is thrown.

label: ITEMINFO_1633
text:
Beautiful stalks of rice bursting with life. Pokémon that
dwell and wander among the fields love these grains and
will gather wherever the stalks are thrown.

label: ITEMINFO_1634
text:
Large, juicy beans that grow in pods. These beans are
beloved by fish Pokémon, as well as bird Pokémon and
their flying ilk, so throw one and they will gather around.

label: ITEMINFO_1635
text:
A large and well-ripened mushroom. It is beloved by the
more monstrous Pokémon, as well as dragon Pokémon,
so they will gather wherever one is thrown.

label: ITEMINFO_1636
text:
Translucent crystals that are beloved by Pokémon
bearing a resemblance to grass, plants, or minerals.
They will gather wherever a lump of this salt is thrown.

label: ITEMINFO_1637
text:
A handy log of wood that can be used for anything,
from crafting common goods needed for daily living
to producing works of art.

label: ITEMINFO_1638
text:
The king of herbs, glittering and brilliant. Combining
this herb with other materials needed to make medicines
will boost their efficacy.

label: ITEMINFO_1639
text:
A mysterious balm that gives off a soothing scent.
It can be used to help calm the frenzy of the Lady of
the Ridge, Lilligant.

label: ITEMINFO_1640
text:
A recipe for crafting Poké Balls from scratch.
Required materials: 1 Apricorn and 1 Tumblestone.

label: ITEMINFO_1641
text:
A recipe for crafting Great Balls from scratch.
Required materials: 1 Apricorn, 1 Iron Chunk, and
1 Tumblestone.

label: ITEMINFO_1642
text:
A recipe for crafting Ultra Balls from scratch.
Required materials: 1 Apricorn, 2 Iron Chunks, and
2 Tumblestones.

label: ITEMINFO_1643
text:
A recipe for crafting Feather Balls from scratch.
Required materials: 1 Apricorn and 1 Sky Tumblestone.

label: ITEMINFO_1644
text:
A recipe for crafting Pokéshi Dolls from scratch.
Required materials: 3 logs of Wood.

label: ITEMINFO_1646
text:
A recipe for crafting Smoke Bombs from scratch.
Required materials: 1 Caster Fern leaf and
1 Sootfoot Root.

label: ITEMINFO_1647
text:
A recipe for crafting Scatter Bangs from scratch.
Required materials: 1 Pop Pod and 1 Caster Fern leaf.

label: ITEMINFO_1648
text:
A recipe for crafting Sticky Globs from scratch.
Required materials: 1 Spoiled Apricorn, 1 Ball of Mud,
and 1 Caster Fern leaf.

label: ITEMINFO_1649
text:
A recipe for crafting Star Pieces from scratch.
Required materials: 3 Red Shards, 3 Blue Shards,
3 Green Shards, and 1 bag of Stardust.

label: ITEMINFO_1650
text:
A recipe for crafting Mushroom Cakes from scratch.
Required materials: 1 Springy Mushroom and
1 Cake-Lure Base.

label: ITEMINFO_1651
text:
A wildflower that can be found growing across the Hisui
region. It does have medicinal properties, but it is
so bitter that no wild Pokémon will eat it.

label: ITEMINFO_1652
text:
A recipe for crafting Honey Cakes from scratch.
Required materials: 1 comb of Dazzling Honey and
1 Cake-Lure Base.

label: ITEMINFO_1653
text:
A recipe for crafting Grain Cakes from scratch.
Required materials: 1 stalk of Hearty Grains and
1 Cake-Lure Base.

label: ITEMINFO_1654
text:
A recipe for crafting Bean Cakes from scratch.
Required materials: 1 pod of Plump Beans and
1 Cake-Lure Base.

label: ITEMINFO_1655
text:
A recipe for crafting Salt Cakes from scratch.
Required materials: 1 hunk of Crunchy Salt and
1 Cake-Lure Base.

label: ITEMINFO_1656
text:
A recipe for crafting Potions from scratch.
Required materials: 1 Oran Berry and 1 Medicinal Leek.

label: ITEMINFO_1657
text:
A recipe for crafting Super Potions from scratch.
Required materials: 1 Potion and 1 Pep-Up Plant.

label: ITEMINFO_1658
text:
A recipe for crafting Hyper Potions from scratch.
Required materials: 1 Super Potion and 1 Vivichoke.

label: ITEMINFO_1659
text:
A recipe for crafting Max Potions from scratch.
Required materials: 1 Sitrus Berry and 1 bunch of
King’s Leaf.

label: ITEMINFO_1660
text:
A recipe for crafting Full Restores from scratch.
Required materials: 1 Max Potion and 1 Full Heal.

label: ITEMINFO_1661
text:
A recipe for crafting Remedies from scratch.
Required materials: 2 Bugwort blooms.

label: ITEMINFO_1662
text:
A recipe for crafting Fine Remedies from scratch.
Required materials: 1 Remedy and 1 Pep-Up Plant.

label: ITEMINFO_1663
text:
A recipe for crafting Superb Remedies from scratch.
Required materials: 1 Fine Remedy and 1 Vivichoke.

label: ITEMINFO_1664
text:
A recipe for crafting Old Gateaux from scratch.
Required materials: 1 pod of Plump Beans, 1 comb of
Dazzling Honey, 1 Sootfoot Root, and 1 Cake-Lure Base.

label: ITEMINFO_1665
text:
A recipe for crafting Jubilife Muffins from scratch.
Required materials: 2 stalks of Hearty Grains,
2 Hopo Berries, 1 Razz Berry, and 1 Cake-Lure Base.

label: ITEMINFO_1666
text:
A recipe for crafting Full Heals from scratch.
Required materials: 1 Cheri Berry, 1 Pecha Berry,
1 Rawst Berry, and 1 Aspear Berry.

label: ITEMINFO_1667
text:
A recipe for crafting Revives from scratch.
Required materials: 1 Vivichoke and 2 Medicinal Leeks.

label: ITEMINFO_1668
text:
A recipe for crafting Max Revives from scratch.
Required materials: 1 Revive and 2 bunches of
King’s Leaf.

label: ITEMINFO_1669
text:
A recipe for crafting Max Ethers from scratch.
Required materials: 1 Leppa Berry and 2 Pep-Up Plants.

label: ITEMINFO_1670
text:
A recipe for crafting Max Elixirs from scratch.
Required materials: 1 Max Ether and 2 bunches of
King’s Leaf.

label: ITEMINFO_1671
text:
A recipe for crafting Stealth Sprays from scratch.
Required materials: 1 Hopo Berry and
3 Bugwort blooms.

label: ITEMINFO_1673
text:
A recipe for crafting Aux Powers from scratch.
Required materials: 2 bunches of Swordcap and
1 Pep-Up Plant.

label: ITEMINFO_1674
text:
A recipe for crafting Aux Guards from scratch.
Required materials: 2 scraps of Iron Barktongue and
1 Pep-Up Plant.

label: ITEMINFO_1675
text:
A recipe for crafting Dire Hits from scratch.
Required materials: 2 Direshrooms and 1 Candy Truffle.

label: ITEMINFO_1676
text:
A recipe for crafting Aux Evasions from scratch.
Required materials: 2 bunches of Doppel Bonnets and
1 Candy Truffle.

label: ITEMINFO_1677
text:
A recipe for crafting Aux Powerguards from scratch.
Required materials: 1 Aux Power, 1 Aux Guard, and
1 bunch of King’s Leaf.

label: ITEMINFO_1678
text:
A mysterious balm that gives off a soothing scent.
It can be used to help calm the frenzy of the Lord of
the Woods, Kleavor.

label: ITEMINFO_1679
text:
A naturally occurring hunk of iron. Such ore is needed
to make the requisite parts of numerous Poké Ball
varieties, such as the clasp that holds the ball shut.

label: ITEMINFO_1681
text:
When combined with an Apricorn, this mysterious
black stone can draw out the properties required
to forge a Heavy Ball.

label: ITEMINFO_1682
text:
When combined with an Apricorn, this mysterious
sky-blue stone can draw out the properties required
to forge a Feather Ball.

label: ITEMINFO_1684
text:
A ball of mud that has become stiff and hard. Hitting a
Pokémon with one may stun the Pokémon, creating an
opening for you to act.

label: ITEMINFO_1686
text:
A sea vegetable used for crafting Scatter Bangs. If you
wrap it up so that the air has no way to escape, then
deal it a sharp blow, it produces a loud popping noise.

label: ITEMINFO_1687
text:
A tuber used for crafting Smoke Bombs. It can be
mashed for use in cooking, but it can also be dried and
ground to produce a fine powder.

label: ITEMINFO_1688
text:
An Apricorn that’s had its insides eaten. Hitting a
Pokémon with one may stun the Pokémon, creating an
opening for you to act.

label: ITEMINFO_1689
text:
A hard ball made of compressed snow. Hitting a
Pokémon with one may stun the Pokémon, creating an
opening for you to act.

label: ITEMINFO_1690
text:
A ball of some kind of sticky substance. Hitting a
Pokémon with one may stun the Pokémon, creating an
opening for you to act.

label: ITEMINFO_1691
text:
A glassy black stone that produces a sharp cutting
edge when split. It’s loved by a certain Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_1692
text:
A block of muddy material that can be used as fuel for
burning when it is dried. It’s loved by a certain Pokémon.

label: ITEMINFO_1693
text:
When used in the field, this spray muffles the sound of
your footsteps and makes wild Pokémon less likely to
notice you for a short time.

label: ITEMINFO_1694
text:
Required for crafting medicinal compounds. This
vegetable is found growing across the Hisui region
and is also known as the wayfarer’s friend.

label: ITEMINFO_1695
text:
Also called a morning-dew bud. It is used as a material
for crafting items that can restore vitality to a Pokémon
that has fainted.

label: ITEMINFO_1696
text:
Extremely spicy but also highly nutritious. This herb is
used as a material for crafting items that can restore PP
to Pokémon or boost their stats.

label: ITEMINFO_1699
text:
A mysterious charm that tends to be lost before any
other item when you faint in the field. This type of charm
comes in five different colors.

label: ITEMINFO_1700
text:
A mysterious charm that tends to be lost before any
other item when you faint in the field. This type of charm
comes in five different colors.

label: ITEMINFO_1701
text:
Mushrooms that, when consumed, cause the muscles
to swell. They imbue the eater with strength and are
one of the materials needed for crafting Aux Powers.

label: ITEMINFO_1702
text:

text:
